haley smalls.bio: Toronto-born singer-songwriter Haley Smalls has built an independent Canadian R&B catalogue around expressive vocals, emotional clarity, and a direct-to-fan release approach.

livingthing.bio: Toronto-based indie electronic artist livingthing blends glitchy production, dreamy synth-pop, ethereal vocals, and introspective writing.

tauro.bio: TAURO is a Toronto collaboration between pianist and singer-songwriter Cynthia Tauro and Broken Social Scene co-founder Brendan Canning, drawing from indie, soul, jazz, R&B, and trip-hop.

puma june.bio: Toronto-based Canadian artist Puma June is a multi-instrumentalist, vocalist, songwriter, and producer whose pop, jazz, hip-hop, and R&B influences meet in a cinematic alt-R&B sound.

lia pappas-kemps.bio: Lia Pappas-Kemps is a Canadian singer-songwriter whose debut album Winged follows the Gleam EP with restrained guitar work, intimate vocals, and carefully paced writing.

löv.bio: LÖV is a Treaty 6 Territory Cree R&B and soul singer-songwriter whose emotionally direct music centres independence, matriarchal strength, and self-definition.

koko love.bio: Montreal artist and producer Koko Love emerged from years of busking and an earlier Miko project with a stripped-back sound spanning soul, alt-pop, and indie.

ghostboyrj.bio: Ghostboyrj (Rohan White) is a Toronto-born, Brampton-raised hip-hop artist and producer whose sample-forward work connects sharp lyricism with underground album-making.
